summary: TraceLab S64 authored-scope parity; worker acceptance remains #479
body:
TraceLab has integrated the authored-scope fixture from DeepSearch implementation 79ef84842fb84259bafe59924b21fe2f5ad05d7d (schema 1.2, semantic revision 3). Canonical contract 8ca1ebfaa604dc7e matches SHA-256 163e7af36080b8440afe55f501b023cb2e3aba84e1b8644298fc0784167b5cb6, including all semantic fields. The vendored compiler remains offline and explicitly structural_only.

Typed context.authored_scope, exact URL references and explicit clearing survive manual/Librarian review, persistence, REST and installed MCP create/update/preview. All eight admission fixtures pass. All four retained outputs are preserved through materialization, API/MCP and UI: compliant 370 words/2 consulted pages; partial 389/1 with availability and independent quality warnings; oversized 660/2 and 22-source 370/22 remain validation_failed. Markdown bytes and original synthesis are retained; full protocol objects survive retrieval and export. Missing or malformed audit data is shown as unknown.

TraceLab PR #413 merged as 566a15c6cc3551d25d69aea0d958e32236401a8d; both services serve that exact revision. Published @aquex/tracelab-mcp 2.1.2 passed a fresh registry install and all 70 stdio checks; all 24 files match the tested tarball (SHA-256 02423e9218f43a02f3b8381d6d2eee5937acc7050091982ba0408c92032911ed). The installed client passed live preview/result calls plus disposable create/PATCH/clear/cleanup. Six authenticated Light/Dark x 390/820/1440 journeys preserve exact Markdown/protocol exports; five production smoke tests pass. Nine required CI gates passed: backend 3159 with 4 skips/12 quarantines, PostgreSQL 171 with 3 skips, frontend 383, browser 94, MCP units 160. Two known legacy CMOS failures remain disclosed; the incomplete local backend attempt is superseded by completed final CI.

Read-only delivery intake observed DeepSearch PR #185 merged at 34ccc4f5f8ded6e14a10523584cc54d45664d2d4 on 2026-10-01 at 23:39 UTC. We have not verified worker runtime or required-run acceptance from that merge.

Existing #479 remains open for your reviewed/deployed worker identity and byte-exact acceptance on a separately authorized required dispatch. We did not operate or deploy DeepSearch, submit paid research or run a hash-only probe. The historical executed bae1333274533285, prior preview 106cb8668a3efdb8 and new fixture identity are distinct. The historical 2,285-versus-2,240 word discrepancy remains unresolved.

Evidence: PR https://github.com/kneelinghorse/TraceLab/pull/413; cmos/reports/sprint-64/S64-VENDOR, S64-SCOPE, S64-RESULT and S64-ACCEPT; cmos/contracts/deepsearch-compiler-vendor.md and mission-authoring-contract.md. This draft is prepared for Derek's review and has not been sent.
